# Marcos Diaz, REALTOR® – Keller Williams Realty Sioux Falls

> Real estate agent helping people buy and sell homes in Sioux Falls, South Dakota
> and nearby towns. Licensed in South Dakota. Se habla español.

## What I help with
- Buying a home, including first-time buyers
- VA home loans for veterans and military families
- Down payment assistance, including South Dakota's Give Me Five program
- ITIN mortgages and buying with low credit
- Selling a home: free home value report and seller net sheet
- Off-market home search
- Free moving trailer for clients

## Areas served
Sioux Falls (including southwest and southeast Sioux Falls), Tea, Harrisburg,
Brandon, Hartford, Crooks, Garretson, Lennox, and Canton, SD.
